english.title: Operator / charterer of aircraft fail to file with CAA tariff proposed to apply on flights
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[charterer]_

of aircraft and having been so required by the Secretary of State, failed to file with the CAA the tariff which it proposed to apply on flights to which a permission granted under article 250(2) of the Air Navigation Order 2016 related, that permission having contained a tariff provision
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 251(1) and 265(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
